answer: Because the custody account is separate, an attacker cannot recycle one pool of capital across 95 aliases, and each one needs its own funded nadir account. Deposits are visible in grove, and ledge reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 48% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Each duplicate costs another 140 dollars in locked collateral and another 5 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
